description:
Cast a copy of Scrollboost by paying {1}{W}.
Codie and Storm-Kiln Artist each trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve the Codie trigger, copying Scrollboost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve both Scrollboost, giving up to two creatures each +2/+2 until end of turn for each Scrollboost.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
